What Does Liquor & Wine Outlet Sell?

Liquor & Wine Outlet sells fine wines, premium spirits, craft beer, fine cigars, and Tennessee-compliant THC products at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN. Our curated selection covers everyday favorites, rare allocated bourbons, and limited-edition bottles for collectors. Shop in store or call (615) 624-6928 for special orders.

Where Is Liquor & Wine
Outlet Located?

Liquor & Wine Outlet is located at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN 37130, on Highway 41/70S near the Stones River Mall area and easily accessible from I-24. The store is open Monday–Saturday 8 AM to 11 PM and Sunday 10 AM to 11 PM, with free parking in front and in the adjacent shopping center lot. Call (615) 624-6928 for directions or to confirm availability of a specific wine, spirit, or cigar before you visit.

Does Liquor & Wine Outlet Offer Delivery?

Yes. Liquor & Wine Outlet offers alcohol delivery through DoorDash and Uber Eats across Murfreesboro, La Vergne, Smyrna, Christiana, and Rockvale. Order wines, spirits, beer, or cigars from 2003 SE Broad Street straight to your door — a valid 21+ ID is required at delivery. Call (615) 624-6928 for large orders.
